dedupe_keys.name: ufhsim dynamic underfloor heating heat pump and building thermal simulation software

description: Mohammad Gheibi, Reza Yeganeh Khaksar and Amirhossein Hoshyar publish UFHSim, a MATLAB application for dynamic underfloor-heating and heat-pump simulations. The July 2026 Zenodo record provides UFHSim.m freely under CC BY 4.0. It describes prediction of indoor temperature, floor heat transfer, heat-pump electricity use and associated energy, economic and environmental measures. Coverage is a configurable residential or commercial building, not an identified field installation. A modeller can use the application to compare heating-system choices and changing environmental conditions, subject to checking its equations and inputs. The public page does not establish a MATLAB version, toolbox requirements, parameter dictionary, time step or validation case. No related catalogue record explicitly covers UFHSim. Runtime software may require a separate MATLAB licence. Numerical stability, calibration and uncertainty remain unknown because the code was not downloaded or executed.
